description: Found by the fz-kdt.80 cold review (2026-08-31): body clause order in the artifact is first-occurrence ROW-ARRIVAL order -- reachable_clauses is built from alternatives.rows() in jobs/semantic.rs:145-163, stored in EntryReachability, materialized verbatim at jobs/artifact.rs:1650-1655. Any change to the key population (e.g. fz-kdt.80's dedupe: clause_ids [0,1]->[1,0] on executable x176) permutes clauses and moves canon, entangling every future precision fix with an incidental permutation. Fix: derive body clause order from body_id/source order at EntryReachability::new (jobs/semantic.rs:164) -- final-packaging ordering, which is the one legal place for a sort (sorting-is-a-barrier law). Red-first: a test that clause order is invariant under row-arrival order (drive two schedules or assert source-order directly). NOTE: landing this itself permutes clause order in existing canon -- a one-time authorized canon re-baseline; coordinate with fz-kdt.80's (i)/(ii) decision. Acceptance: canon stable under key-population perturbation; behavior/inventory unchanged.
title: Artifact clause order is row-arrival order: a schedule coupling that trips canon on any key-population change
